pieces.Text: You can inspire tremendous heroism in yourself or up to

allies within 30 feet. To inspire heroics, all of the targets must be able to see and hear you. Inspired creatures gain a +4 morale bonus on saving throws and a +4 dodge bonus to AC. This effect lasts for as long as the targets are able to witness your performance. Inspire heroics is a mind-affecting ability that relies on audible and visual components.
